1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bb5 Nd4 5..strategy: Holds the e5 knight with a pawn so that White keeps the extra pawn, at the price of loosening the king's side and the e1-h4 diagonal. Black can trade on b5 and undermine the knight, regaining the pawn because the knight leaves e4 unprotected.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bb5 Nd4 5..name: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation, Rubinstein Variation
